_not_transcribed: Every table of the chapter is transcribed, in every edition that prints it: the récapitulation (prisons_population_recap), condemned prisoners by nationality, age, sex and penal category (prisons_condemned_nationality_age), by nationality, offence and sentence (prisons_condemned_offence), c) days of work (prisons_work_days, sgt1922-sgt1935), d) expenditure and days of detention (prisons_expenditure, sgt1922-sgt1935), the two mouvement général tables (prisons_movement, sgt1922-sgt1939), transfers (prisons_transfers, sgt1922-sgt1935), deaths by prison and disease (prisons_deaths, sgt1922-sgt1935) and guard staff against the maximum daily population (prisons_guard_staff, sgt1922-sgt1935). The page-by-page re-survey of every view listed above (contact sheets of every view from the chapter title to the next chapter, each table then read on native-resolution crops) found one table the first survey had missed, sgt1935 c) journées de travail (f84-f85, now in prisons_work_days), and nothing else: the remaining views are titles, blank pages and the next chapter. Footnotes are kept in the notes files (expenditure and guard-staff footnotes (1) are also stored as cells).
